blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recognizing facial expressions in unconstrained video suffers from two coupled problems: self-attention grows quadratically in cost with clip length, and crowdsourced labels are noisy. We present GM-GReFEL, a spatiotemporal state-space network with a geometry-aware decision stage. Its Modulated GroupMamba backbone replaces a spatiotemporal Vision Transformer. Six channel groups are scanned separately, four over the frame plane and two over time, so the cost grows linearly with sequence length ($\mathcal{O}(N)$); after each layer, a Channel Affinity Modulation gate mixes the groups again. On top of the backbone, a GReFEL reliability module turns the normalized entropy of each prediction into a mixing weight between the classifier output and a vote from trainable geometric anchors, so that facial geometry counts for more when the network is unsure. The model is initialized by static-to-dynamic weight transfer and trained with a Triple Loss. In five-fold cross-validation, the best fold scores 66.57\%/76.46\% UAR/WAR on DFEW, 0.3 points or less below the strongest compared method, and 45.66\%/62.27\% on MAFW, ahead of all compared methods; on FERV39k the mean over five splits, 42.30\%/52.66\%, is competitive. The five-fold means are 64.07\%/74.54\% on DFEW, on par with recent large pre-trained models, and 38.90\%/54.37\% on MAFW, below the best of them. A paired $t$-test on DFEW indicates a modest benefit of temporal modeling (+1.61 UAR points, one-sided $p=0.031$). Attention stays on plausible facial regions, and latency is close to a ViT-B/16 baseline (47.4 vs.\ 46.8 ms per clip). Code: https://github.com/ardiytama/GroupMamba-DFER.
blocks.zh: 在不受限制的视频中识别面部表情有两种连带问题:自觉性以剪辑长度以四倍的成本增长,以及众包标签的噪音. 我们介绍GM-GREFEL,这是一个具有几何意识决策阶段的瞬间状态-空间网络。 其Modulated GroupMamba骨干取代了spatiopal Vision变形器. 6个频道组单独扫描,4个在帧平面上扫描,2个在时间上扫描,因此成本随序列长度(\mathcal{O}(N)$)而呈线性增长;每层之后,一个频道Afffinity Modulating门再次混合各组. 在骨干之上,一个GREFEL可靠性模块将每个预测的常态化的演化演化成分类器输出和可训练几何锚的投票之间的混合重量,这样,当网络不确定时面部几何就算数更多. 该模型通过静态到动力的重量转移进行初始化,并经过三重损失的训练. 在五倍的交叉验证中,最佳折叠分数在DFEW上为66.57=76.46=UAR/WAR,比最强的比法低0.3分或更低;在MAFW上为45.66=62.27=,领先于所有比较方法;在FERV39k上,平均分数超过5分,42.30=52.66===,具有竞争力. 这五重手段是:在DFEW上是64.07+74.54++,与最近培训过的大型模型相同;在MAFW上是38.90+54.37+,低于其中最好的。 对DFEW进行一对美元测试表明,时间建模的效益不大(+1.61 UAR点,单侧美元=0.031美元)。 注意力集中在貌似合理的面部区域,延迟接近Vit-B/16基线(每片47.4对46.8毫秒). 代码:https://github.com/ardiytama/GroupMamba-DFER. 互联网档案馆的存檔,存档日期2013-03-02.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Human emotion unfolds over time: a spontaneous smile builds from a neutral baseline, peaks, and relaxes, while a flash of disgust may last only a few frames. Static facial expression recognition (SFER) on cropped single frames [ 16 ] discards this temporal structure, which is why dynamic facial expression recognition (DFER) analyzes continuous video instead. Large in-the-wild benchmarks such as FERV39k [ 1 ] , DFEW [ 2 ] , and MAFW [ 3 ] have made the task considerably harder by adding unconstrained illumination, camera motion, and occlusion.
blocks.zh: 人类的情感随时间推移而出:自发的微笑从中性基线,高峰和放松中相接而来,而一闪一闪的厌恶可能只会持续到几帧. 被收割的单帧上的静态面部表情识别(SFER)[16]抛弃了这种时间结构,这就是动态面部表情识别(DFER)分析连续视频的原因. 诸如FERV39k [1], DFEW [2] 和 MAFW [3] 等巨大的内在基准,通过增加不受约束的照明,相机运动,和被隔离,使得任务更加艰巨.

blocks.en: Two obstacles remain largely unresolved. The first is computational. Spatiotemporal Vision Transformers [ 4 , 5 ] link distant frames directly, but self-attention scales as 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) in the number of tokens N N , forcing a trade-off between clip length, spatial resolution, and GPU memory. Selective state-space models such as Mamba [ 6 ] match the long-range capacity of attention at 𝒪 ⁡ ( N ) \mathcal{O}(N) cost and have been adapted to images [ 7 , 8 ] and video [ 9 ] , but not around the geometric priors specific to facial expression. The second obstacle is label noise. Crowdsourced annotators frequently disagree on ambiguous or transitional expressions [ 11 , 12 ] , and a network trained with plain cross-entropy absorbs this noise, producing the well-documented bias toward majority classes such as “Happy” and “Neutral” [ 26 , 27 ] .
blocks.zh: 两个障碍基本上仍未解决。 第一个是计算。 Spatiotemporal Vision Transformers [4, 5] 将相距较远的相框直接连接起来,但自意的相框作为O → (N 2 )\ mathcal{O} (N^{2}) 在指使N N 的数量中,强制在剪接长度,空间分辨率,和GPU内存之间取舍. 有选择的状态-空间模型,如Mamba [6] 匹配了O ⁡ (N)\ mathcal{ (N) 成本的远程关注能力,并被被改编成图像 [7,8]和视频 [9],但并非围绕着面部表情所特有的几何前缀. 第二个障碍是标签噪音。 人群来源的注解者常常对模糊或过渡性表达方式[11,12]有不同意见,受过平地跨入性训练的网络吸收了这种噪音,产生了对多数阶层如“快乐”和“Neutral”的有据可查的偏见[26,27]。

blocks.en: We argue that the two problems should be solved jointly: an efficient backbone without a noise-robust decision layer still overfits corrupted labels, while a robust decision layer on a quadratic backbone still cannot observe enough of the clip. GM-GReFEL couples a linear-complexity spatiotemporal state-space engine with a reliability mechanism grounded in facial geometry. Our contributions are as follows. • Modulated GroupMamba engine. Each layer partitions the channels into six groups, scans four of them across the frame and two across time with a Visual Single Selective Scan, and merges them again through a Channel Affinity Modulation gate. Texture and motion thus get separate pathways while the cost of the extractor stays linear in N N . • Entropy-guided geometric reliability. We carry GReFEL [ 13 ] over from images to video. How uncertain a prediction is, measured by its normalized entropy, decides per sample how much the output relies on the classifier and how much on a cosine-similarity vote against trainable class anchors; under occlusion, blur, or ambiguity the anchors dominate. • Static-to-Dynamic transfer and Triple Loss. Spatial weights and anchors learned on still images are inflated into the video model, the temporal parameters start close to zero, and two extra loss terms (anchor orthogonality and center loss) are meant to stop the anchors from collapsing. • Comprehensive and transparent evaluation. On its best fold, GM-GReFEL gives the highest UAR and WAR among all compared methods on MAFW and comes within 0.3 points of the strongest method, S4D, on DFEW. We report the five-fold mean next to every best-fold figure: it is comparable to recent pre-trained models on DFEW and lower on MAFW, and the FERV39k result is competitive. The evaluation is supported by a paired t t -test on DFEW, component and hyperparameter ablations, Grad-CAM and t t -SNE analyses, and a compute comparison against a ViT-B/16 baseline.
blocks.zh: 我们主张两个问题应该共同解决:一个高效的骨干,没有噪声大压决策层,仍然过于腐败的标签,而一个四面体骨干上强大的决策层仍然无法充分观察剪辑. GM-GREFEL 配有一款线性-复杂相片态-空间引擎,其可靠性机制基于面相几何. 我们的贡献如下。 • GroupMamba发动机。 每层将频道分成六组,用可视化的单相选择扫描扫描扫描了其中四组和两组,再通过通道Afffinity Moduction门再次合并. 因此,在提取器的成本保持在N N 线性时,纹理和运动会获得单独的路径。 我们把GREFEL[13] 从图像到视频。 一个预测如何不确定,用它的常态 en来衡量,决定每个样本的输出在多大程度上依赖于分类器,以及在何种程度上依赖于对可训练级锚的同位素-同位素投票;在被隔离,模糊,或模糊的情况下,锚被主导. • 静态到动态转移和三重损失。 在静态图像上学到的空间分量和锚被夸大到视频模型中,时间参数开始接近于零,另外两个额外损失术语(锚地正交和中心损失)是为了阻止锚地倒塌. • 全面而透明的评价。 GM-GREFEL在MAFW的所有比较方法中给出了最高的UAR和WAR,并在DFEW上达到最强方法S4D的0.3分以内. 我们报告每个最佳数字旁边的五倍平均值:它与最近对DFEW进行预先培训的模型和对MAFW进行较低的模型相比,FERV39k结果具有竞争力。 辅助评价的有:对DFEW、组件和高参数活度、Grad-CAM和t-SNE分析的对t t测试,以及与Vit-B/16基准的计算比较。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A From Image-Based to Video-Based Expression Analysis
blocks.zh: 从图像到视频表达分析

blocks.en: Early DFER systems extracted frame-level features with a 2D CNN and modeled temporal order with a recurrent network, an approach that tracks short-term changes but degrades over long clips because of vanishing gradients. 3D convolutional backbones such as C3D [ 18 ] , P3D [ 19 ] , I3D [ 20 ] , and R(2+1)D [ 21 ] compute motion within a single tensor operation. Their fixed receptive field, however, captures rapid local motion more readily than slowly forming expressions, and enlarging the kernels raises the parameter count and the risk of overfitting imbalanced in-the-wild collections like DFEW [ 2 ] , FERV39k [ 1 ] , and MAFW [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 早期的DFER系统提取出带有2D CNN的帧级功能,并用一个经常性的网络模拟了时间顺序,这种方法跟踪短期变化,但由于梯度消失而通过长片段降解. 由C3D [18],P3D [19],I3D [20],R(2+1)D[21]等三维回旋骨干在单一的收发式操作中计算出运动. 然而,它们的固定可接受域比缓慢地形成表达式更容易捕捉到快的局部运动,而扩大内核则会提高参数计数,以及像 DFEW [2], FERV39k [1],和 MAFW [3] 这样的杂乱集合过度匹配的风险.

blocks.en: II-B Face-Detection-Free DFER Paradigms
blocks.zh: II-B 免面部检测-无外观 实例

blocks.en: Most DFER pipelines, including ours, assume a face detection and alignment (FDA) stage that crops the face before temporal modeling. PTH-Net [ 46 ] questions this assumption by recognizing expressions directly from raw video: a frozen video backbone extracts a temporal feature pyramid at multiple frequencies, and a Temporal Hierarchy Refinement architecture with a Scalable Semantic Distinction layer separates target from non-target frames, preserving body-language cues that cropping discards. Because GM-GReFEL’s geometric anchors rely on a stable, aligned facial region, we see the FDA-free paradigm as complementary to ours, and extending the reliability mechanism to unaligned frames is a separate research direction.
blocks.zh: 包括我国在内的大多数DFER输油管都采用面相检测和对接(FDA)阶段,在时间建模之前将面相收割。 PTH-Net [46] 通过直接从原始视频识别表达来质疑这一假设:被冷冻的视频骨干在多频率时提取出一个时空特征金字塔,以及具有可伸缩语义区分层的Timporal Sierarchy Refinement 架构将目标与非目标帧区分开来,保留了裁剪丢弃的体能提示. 因为GM-GREFEL的几何锚地依赖于一个稳定、相通的面部区域,所以我们认为FDA的无相范式是对我们的补充,而将可靠性机制扩展到不相通的相框是另外的研究方向.

blocks.en: II-C Transformer-Based Spatiotemporal Modeling
blocks.zh: II-C 基于变形器的 Spatiotemal 建模

blocks.en: ViViT [ 4 ] and MViT [ 5 ] brought global self-attention to video, and Former-DFER [ 23 ] and STT [ 24 ] applied it to facial video. Later work addressed label noise (NR-DFERNet [ 26 ] ), majority-class collapse (IAL [ 27 ] ), and multi-instance learning (M3DFEL [ 28 ] ); CLIP-based methods (DFER-CLIP [ 32 ] , EmoCLIP [ 33 ] , A 3 lign-DFER [ 34 ] ) inject vision-language priors, and masked-autoencoder methods (MAE-DFER [ 37 ] , VideoMAE [ 17 ] , HiCMAE [ 36 ] , SVFAP [ 35 ] ) pursue label-efficient pre-training. Static-to-dynamic methods such as S2D [ 38 ] and S4D [ 39 ] transfer image-level facial priors to video, as our initialization does. All of these retain a self-attention core whose 𝒪 ⁡ ( N 2 ) \mathcal{O}(N^{2}) cost limits the resolution and clip length they can process.
blocks.zh: ViViT [4]和MViT [5] 给视频带来了全球自觉,而前DFER [23]和STT [24]将其应用于面部视频. 后来的工作涉及标签噪声(NR-DFERNet [26]),多数级崩溃(IAL [27]),以及多进取学习(M3DFEL [28]);基于CLIP的方法(DFER-CLIP [32],EmoCLIP [33],A 3 lign-DFER [34])注射视觉语前缀,并有口罩的自动编码方法(MAE-DFER [37],视频MAE [17],HiCMAE [36],SVFAP [35])追求标签效率高的前培训. S2D[38]和S4D[39]等静态到动力学方法将图像级面部前传到视频,就像我们的初始化一样. 所有这些都保留了一个自留心核心,其O → (N 2 )\ mathcal{O} (N^{2}) 成本限制了它们可以处理的分辨率和剪接长度.

blocks.en: II-D Selective State-Space Backbones in Vision
blocks.zh: II-D 愿景中的选择状态空间后骨

blocks.en: Structured state space models propagate an input through a latent state, but early deep-learning variants used fixed transition parameters and could not filter tokens by content. Mamba [ 6 ] made the step size and projections input-dependent, allowing a linear-time recurrence to discard uninformative tokens while approximating the long-range reasoning of attention. VMamba [ 7 ] and Vision Mamba [ 8 ] adapted this recurrence to 2D images through cross-scan and bidirectional scanning, VideoMamba [ 9 ] extended it to video, and GroupMamba [ 10 ] , on which we build, partitions channels into groups with distinct scan directions re-coupled by a channel modulation gate. To our knowledge, no prior work combines grouped linear-complexity scanning with an explicit geometric reliability mechanism for facial expression recognition.
blocks.zh: 结构化的状态空间模型通过潜伏状态传播出一种输入,但早期的深层学习变体使用固定的过渡参数,不能通过内容来过滤符号. Mamba [6] 使步骤大小和预测输入依赖性,允许线性时间重现以丢弃非成像符而同时近似关注的长距离推理. VMamba[7]和Vision Mamba[8]通过交叉扫描和双向扫描将这种重现改编为2D图像,VideoMamba[9]将其扩展为视频,GroupMamba[10],我们在此基础上将各频道分割成各组,并有明显的扫描方向被频道调制闸门重接. 据我们所知,没有前作将分类线性复杂扫描与面部表情识别的清晰几何可靠性机制结合起来.

blocks.en: II-E Label Noise and Geometric Reliability
blocks.zh: II-E 标签噪声和几何可靠性

blocks.en: In-the-wild DFER labels come from crowdsourced annotation, and annotators disagree on subtle or occluded expressions [ 11 , 12 ] . Networks trained on such labels first learn generalizable patterns and later memorize incorrect labels [ 11 ] . Statistical remedies redistribute probability across plausible classes or spread attention across facial regions [ 12 ] , while center-loss [ 14 ] and margin-based objectives [ 15 ] tighten class clusters; however, all of them correct ambiguity using the same pixel evidence that produced it. GReFEL [ 13 ] instead introduces an anatomically grounded anchor that is independent of image quality, validating predictions against geometric facial-landmark statistics. We extend this idea from static images to video, replacing a fixed weighting with a per-sample, entropy-based mixing coefficient.
blocks.zh: 模糊的DFER标签来源于众说纷纭的注解,而注释者对微妙或隐蔽的表达方式有分歧[11,12]. 接受过这类标签培训的网络首先学习通俗模式,然后记住不正确的标签[11]。 统计补救方法将概率重新分配到各种可能的类别,或将注意力分散到面部区域[12],而中心损失[14]和以比值为基础的目标[15]则收紧了类群;然而,所有这些方法都用产生这些类群的同像素证据纠正了模糊之处. GREFEL [13] 转而引入了独立于图像质量的解剖定位锚,验证了与几何面部-地标统计的预测. 我们把这个想法从静态的图像扩展到视频, 用一个以每个样本为基础的混合系数代替固定的加权。

blocks.en: II-F Summary and Positioning
blocks.zh: 二-F 概述和定位

blocks.en: Efficient sequence modeling and geometric reliability have so far progressed separately: linear-complexity backbones lack an explicit reliability check, and GReFEL has been formulated only for static images. GM-GReFEL closes this joint gap, using Mamba-style scanning to remove the quadratic cost and letting the network’s own predictive entropy decide how much weight the geometric evidence receives.
blocks.zh: 高效的序列建模和几何可靠性迄今为止已经单独地取得进展:线性-复杂主干线缺乏明确的可靠性检查,而GREFEL只为静态图像被制定. GM-GREFEL关闭了这个联想缺口,

blocks.en: III Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 三 拟议方法

blocks.en: III-A Overview
blocks.zh: 三. A 概览

blocks.en: The overall GM-GReFEL pipeline is illustrated in Fig. 1 . A raw video clip is first temporally resampled and spatially normalized (Section III-B ), then partitioned into 3D spatiotemporal tubelets and linearly projected into a token sequence (Section III-C ). This sequence is processed by a stack of Modulated GroupMamba layers, in which the channel dimension is split into six groups that are scanned along four spatial directions and two temporal directions using a Visual Single Selective Scan, then re-fused by a Channel Affinity Modulation gate (Section III-D ). The resulting dense motion-aware feature vector is passed to the Geometry-Aware Reliability module, which computes the network’s own predictive entropy and blends the primary classification with a geometrically grounded vote accordingly (Section III-E ). All parts are optimized jointly under a Triple Loss objective (Section III-E ) after a Static-to-Dynamic weight-transfer initialization phase (Section III-F ). Section III-G formalizes the resulting computational complexity.

blocks.en: IV-A 1 Datasets
blocks.zh: IV-A 1 数据集

blocks.en: Three in-the-wild benchmarks are used. DFEW [ 2 ] contains over 16,000 clips taken from films, with severe illumination variation and occlusion. FERV39k [ 1 ] is the largest scene-diverse benchmark currently available and is strongly skewed toward “Happy” and “Neutral”. MAFW [ 3 ] has 11 compound-emotion classes, including anxiety, helplessness, and disappointment, which overlap in facial geometry with the seven basic emotions. All results are obtained under strict 5-fold cross-validation, with every video functioning as held-out test data in exactly one fold. For DFEW and MAFW we report two numbers. The first is the best of the five cross-validation folds, which shows what the model can reach. The second, the five-fold mean with its standard deviation, shows how stable that result is. As far as we are aware, the baseline figures in our tables are reported as five-fold averages, so the five-fold mean is the like-for-like comparison and the best fold is an upper bound; the comparison tables therefore show both. For FERV39k, the reported figure is the mean over the five splits, for the reason given in Section IV-C . The checkpoint reported for a fold depends on the dataset, and in every case it is chosen on the evaluation fold itself. For DFEW, the best-fold and five-fold figures come from re-evaluating the saved best checkpoint of each fold with one evaluation script, so the per-class recalls, UAR, and WAR of a fold belong to the same checkpoint. This evaluation is not bit-wise deterministic: repeating it on the Fold 5 checkpoint changed the UAR by 0.35 points and the WAR by 0.18 points (Section IV-C ), which indicates the size of the evaluation noise. For MAFW, each split is taken at its epoch of peak WAR, and for FERV39k the best checkpoint is evaluated at the end of training. The ablation uses each fold at its epoch of peak UAR, with the WAR taken at that epoch. blocks.en: IV-B Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-B 分析

blocks.en: This section examines the contribution of each architectural component, tests the DFEW gain for statistical significance, and characterizes how consistently that performance is achieved across data splits.
blocks.zh: 本节审查每个建筑部分的贡献,测试DFEW收益的统计意义,并描述在数据分割中实现业绩的一致性。

blocks.en: IV-B 1 Component Ablation
blocks.zh: 构成部分1

blocks.en: Table I gives the DFEW performance of the full model and of five variants, each with one component removed or reduced. All rows come from the same five-fold ablation series and are reported as mean ± \pm SD over the five folds. They are therefore not comparable with the best-fold headline of Section IV-C .
blocks.zh: 表一列出全模型和五个变体的DFEW性能,每个变体有一个组件被去掉或缩小. 所有行出自同为五倍的活化序列并被报告为正 ±\pm SD 在五倍相上. 因此,它们与第四至C节最佳标题不相上下。

blocks.en: Removing temporal modeling produces the only clear change: UAR falls from 64.69% to 63.08%, a loss of 1.61 points, which is examined further in the paired test below. The other four variants stay within 0.3 points of the full model in mean UAR (from − 0.26 -0.26 to + 0.29 +0.29 ). This is small next to the fold-to-fold SD of 1.5 to 2.2 points, so five-fold experiments of this kind cannot separate the contribution of these components from noise. In WAR, no component shows a benefit: the variants score between 0.1 and 1.3 points higher than the full model, again about one SD.
blocks.zh: 移除时间模型产生的唯一明显变化是:UAR从64.69%下降到63.08%,损失1.61分,下面的对接测试将对此作进一步检查. 其他四种变体在平均UAR(从−0.26-0.26到+0.29+0.29)中保持在完整模型的0.3分以内. 这在1.5到2.2分的折叠相接自毁的旁边很小,因此这种五倍的实验无法将这些元件的贡献与噪声相分离. 在WAR中,没有组件显示好处:变体得分比全型高0.1至1.3分,再次是约一SD.

blocks.en: Our conclusion is therefore limited. In this setting, temporal modeling is the component with a measurable effect on accuracy. The trainable anchors, the three-layer GroupMamba-SSM stack, the two-stage schedule, and jittered sampling were included for design reasons described in Section III : a geometric reliability check, stable early optimization, and variety in the sampled frames. Their effect on average accuracy is not measurable here, and we do not claim that they improve it. These experiments also do not test whether they help training stability or the best-fold results.
blocks.zh: 因此,我们的结论有限。 在这种背景下,时间模型是能够对准确性产生可测量影响的组成部分. 可训练锚地,三层组门巴-SSM堆地,两相分级时间表,以及焦躁的采样,因设计原因被列入第三节:几何可靠性检查,稳定的早期优化,被采样框的品种. 它们对平均准确性的影响在这里是无法衡量的,我们并不声称它们改善了这种影响。 这些实验也没有检验它们是否有助于训练稳定性或最佳效果。

blocks.en: IV-B 2 Hyperparameter Sensitivity
blocks.zh: 四-B 2 超参数 敏感性

blocks.en: We swept five training hyperparameters on DFEW Fold 1 under an accelerated 50-epoch schedule, since a full 5-fold sweep at four values each would need 100 training runs. The default configuration ( p = 0.5 p=0.5 , L = 3 L=3 ) appears twice in the sweep and reaches 63.62% and 61.70% UAR, so repeated runs of the same configuration differ by about two points, and smaller differences should not be read as effects. Table II gives the best value for each hyperparameter, and the complete results are in the Supplementary Material. Dropout and the two Triple Loss weights show no clear effect. The temperature τ = 0.10 \tau=0.10 gives the highest UAR (65.20%), 1.5 to 2.2 points above the other values, which is suggestive but not conclusive. A single GroupMamba layer scores highest in this short schedule (64.19% UAR), which may reflect faster convergence of the smaller model, and L = 5 L=5 collapses to near-chance accuracy under the S2D initialization. We kept L = 3 L=3 , the depth chosen in the initial design of the model, as the default throughout for continuity across experiments. The later sweep and the five-fold ablation of Table I show no measurable difference between L = 3 L=3 and L = 1 L=1 (64.69% against 64.94% UAR in the ablation, within the fold-to-fold SD), so this choice does not change our conclusions.
blocks.zh: 我们在DFEW Fold 1上按照一个50世纪的加速时间表扫射了5个训练超参数,因为以4个值进行全5倍的扫射需要100次训练。 默认配置(p = 0.5 p = 0.5,L = 3 L = 3)在扫描中两次出现并达到63.62%和61.70%的UAR,因此同一配置的重复运行相差约2分,较小的差异不应被解读为效果. 表二给出了每个超参数的最佳值,完整结果载于补充材料. 退学和两个"三失"重量显示没有明显效果. 气温τ=0.10\tau=0.10给出了最高的UAR(65.20%),比其他值高1.5到2.2分,这是暗示性的,但不是结论性的. 单组曼巴地层的得分在这一短的计分表中最高(64.19% UAR),这可能反映更小的模型更快的趋同,而L = 5 L = 5 在 S2D 初始化下倒向近切斯精度. 我们保留了L = 3 L = 3,即模型初始设计中选择的深度,作为整个实验连续性的默认. 后期的扫瞄和表一的五倍膨胀显示L=3L=3和L=1L=1之间没有可测量的区别(64.69%对64.94%的UAR在膨胀中,在折叠到倍的SD内),所以这个选择不会改变我们的结论.

blocks.en: IV-B 3 Statistical Significance
blocks.zh: IV-B 3 统计意义

blocks.en: To see whether temporal modeling gives a reliable gain on DFEW, we compared the full model with a spatial-only baseline using a paired t t -test over the five cross-validation folds. In the baseline, frame-level features are mean-pooled over time and no sequential module is used; two-stage training and selective sampling stay active so that the comparison is fair. The null hypothesis is that temporal modeling brings no UAR benefit. We use a one-sided test because the hypothesis is directional.
blocks.zh: 为了了解时间模型是否给DFEW带来可靠的收益,我们用一对 t - t -测试比对了5个交叉验证折叠,将完整的模型与仅限空间的基线进行比较. 在基线中,帧级特征随时间而平均集合,不使用相继模块;两阶段培训和选择性采样保持活性,以便比较公平. 无效的假设是,时间建模没有带来UAR的好处. 我们使用单方面的测试,因为假设是方向性的.

blocks.en: The full model has the higher UAR in four of the five folds, and the mean paired difference is +1.61 points (SD 1.41; t ⁡ ( 4 ) = 2.56 t(4)=2.56 ). The one-sided p p -value is 0.031, which is below 0.05, so we reject the null hypothesis at that level. The two-sided p p -value is 0.063, and the 95% confidence interval for the mean difference is [ − 0.14 , 3.36 ] [-0.14,\,3.36] points. The gain is therefore modest, and the evidence for it is moderate, not strong; in Fold 3 the baseline is marginally better ( − 0.15 -0.15 points). The per-fold values are listed in the Supplementary Material. The full-model mean here (64.69% UAR) is that of Table I ; it differs from the DFEW mean in Table III (64.07%) because the two use different checkpoint-selection rules (Section IV-A ).
blocks.zh: 全型车型有5个折叠中4个中较高的UAR,平均对接差为+1.61分(SD 1.41;t QQ (4)=2.56t(4)=2.56分). 单侧p-值为0.031,低于0.05,因此我们拒绝该等值的无效假设. 双面p-值为0.063,平均差值的95%置信间隔为[−0.14, 3.36] [-0.14,\, 3.36]分. 因此,收益不大,其证据是适度的,不是强有力的;在Fold 3中,基线略好(-0.15-0.15分)。 每倍数值列于补充材料中。 这里的全模表示(64.69%的UAR)是表一;它与表三中的DFEW表示(64.07%)不同,因为两者使用不同的检查站选取规则(第四节A.

blocks.en: The test was run on DFEW only. The five-fold baseline was trained on DFEW alone because five-fold training of the Modulated GroupMamba engine is computationally expensive, so there are no paired results for FERV39k or MAFW and we make no statistical claim for them. With only five folds the test has low power, and we present it as supporting evidence for DFEW and not as a general guarantee.
blocks.zh: 测试只在DFEW上进行. 仅DFEW就训练了五倍基线,因为Moduled GroupMamba引擎的五倍训练在计算上是昂贵的,因此FERV39k或MAFW没有成对结果,我们也没有统计索赔. 只有5个折叠测试的功率较低,我们把它作为DFEW的支持证据,而不是一般的保证.

blocks.en: IV-B 4 Cross-Fold Stability
blocks.zh: IV-B 4 交叉式稳定

blocks.en: The DFEW and MAFW figures in the main comparison tables are the best cross-validation folds, whereas the FERV39k figure is the five-split mean (Section IV-C ). A best fold does not show how reliably a result is reached, so Table III summarizes all five folds of the same runs by mean and standard deviation; the per-fold values are in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 主要比较表中的DFEW和MAFW数字是最佳的交叉验证折叠,而FERV39k数字是五分相正值(第四节-C节)。 最佳折叠不能显示结果的可靠程度,因此表三以平均值和标准偏差概括了相同运行的所有五个折叠;每倍值在"补充材料"中.

blocks.en: On DFEW, the best fold (Fold 5) reaches 66.57% UAR and 76.46% WAR, and the five-fold mean is 64.07% UAR / 74.54% WAR ( ± \pm 1.80 / ± \pm 1.54). FERV39k shows the tightest spread ( ± \pm 0.84 / ± \pm 0.69); its best split (43.68% / 53.81%) lies above the reported five-split mean (42.30% / 52.66%). MAFW shows the widest spread ( ± \pm 5.65 / ± \pm 6.35), consistent with an 11-way label space and few samples per class; its Fold 4 (45.66% / 62.27% at epoch 38) matches the headline result, while the remaining folds range from 31.51% to 43.31% UAR, so the headline value marks the upper end of the fold distribution.
blocks.zh: 在DFEW上,最好的折叠(Fold 5)达到66.57%的UAR和76.46%的WAR,而五倍的平均值为64.07%的UAR/74.54%的WAR (±\pm 1.80 /±\pm 1.54). blocks.en: IV-C Comparison With Published Methods
blocks.zh: 四-C 与公布方法的比较

blocks.en: IV-C 1 DFEW
blocks.zh: 四-C 1 DFEW

blocks.en: Table IV compares GM-GReFEL against a broad set of DFER baselines spanning 3D CNNs, recurrent hybrids, and Transformer architectures. The best fold of our five-fold run (Fold 5) reaches 66.57% UAR and 76.46% WAR. The UAR is 9.12 points above the strongest UAR among the older baselines in the table (MIDAS [ 30 ] , 57.45%, shown rounded to 57.4%) and 0.23 points below S4D (66.8% UAR, 76.6% WAR), the strongest large-scale pre-trained model in Table VII ; the WAR is 0.14 points below S4D. Most compared methods are reported as five-fold averages, so the fairer comparison is our five-fold mean of 64.07% UAR and 74.54% WAR, given in the last row of Table IV . On that basis GM-GReFEL is 6.6 points above MIDAS, close to MAE-DFER and VideoMAE (63.4% and 63.6% UAR), and 2.7 points below S4D. For both GM-GReFEL rows, the per-class recalls, UAR, and WAR come from one evaluation of the saved best checkpoint of each fold, so the UAR equals the mean of the seven per-class recalls.
blocks.zh: 表四比较 GM-GREFEL针对一系列广泛的DFER基线,包括3DCNN、经常性混合体和变形器结构。 我们的五倍跑(五分之一)的最佳折叠率达到66.57%的UAR和76.46%的WAR. UAR在表中较老的基线(MIDAS [30],57.45%,四舍五入为57.4%)和S4D下0.23分(66.8% UAR,76.6% WAR)中比最强的UAR高9.12分,是表七中最强的大型预训模型;WAR比S4D低0.14分. 比较方法大多为五倍平均值,因此,较公平的比较是表四最后一行给出的五倍平均值,即64.07%的铀和74.54%的WAR。 据此,GM-GREFEL在MIDS上方6.6分,接近MAE-DFER和VideoMAE(63.4%和63.6%),低于S4D2.7分. 对于GM-GREFEL两行,每等回想,UAR,和WAR都来自对每等回想所保存的最佳检查点的一个评价,所以UAR等于每等回想7的平均值.

blocks.en: Per-fold recall shows that majority classes such as “Happy” are essentially bulletproof across folds (91.2–94.9%), while minority classes like “Disgust” show substantially more inter-fold variance, which we attribute to the scarcity of samples in those splits (full per-fold breakdown in the Supplementary Material).

blocks.en: In the best fold, the recall is 94.3% on Happy, 85.7% on Sad, and 80.7% on Angry, while the minority classes Fear (49.4%) and Disgust (24.1%) remain the weakest (Table IV ). Fig. 3 shows the normalized confusion matrix of the Fold 5 checkpoint from a repeated evaluation. Because the evaluation is not bit-wise deterministic, the repetition differs slightly from Table IV : the UAR changes by 0.35 points, the WAR by 0.18 points, and the largest change in a single recall is 3.4 points, which is one of the 29 Disgust test clips (8 instead of 7 correct). We therefore use the figure only to show the pattern of confusions. Misclassifications follow facial anatomy: “Disgust” is confused with “Neutral” (34%) and “Angry” (17%), and “Fear” bleeds into “Surprise” (17%), since both expressions widen the eyes in a similar way.
blocks.zh: 最好的情况是,在Happy上召回率为94.3%,在Sad上召回率为85.7%,在愤怒上召回率为80.7%,而少数阶层(49.4%)和Disgust(24.1%)仍然是最弱的(表四)。 图3显示反复评价的Fold 5检查站的正常混淆矩阵。 由于评价不是位取决定性的,重复与表四略有不同:UAR变化0.35分,WAR变化0.18分,一次召回的最大变化是3.4分,这是29个Disgust测试片段之一(8分而不是7分正确). 因此,我们只用这个数字来显示混乱的模式。 “Disgust”与“Neutral”(34%)和“Angry”(17%)相混淆,“害怕”流血为“Surprise”(17%),因为这两种表达方式都以类似方式拓宽了眼睛。

blocks.en: IV-C 2 FERV39k
blocks.zh: IV-C 2 FERV39k

blocks.en: FERV39k presents an even more severe class-imbalance challenge than DFEW, with minority emotions such as “Disgust” and “Fear” constituting a small fraction of the dataset. Table V compares GM-GReFEL against the strongest published baselines. Among the methods in Table V , the strongest UAR was 35.94% (M3DFEL [ 28 ] ); GM-GReFEL raises this to 42.30%, a +6.36-point gain, with WAR reaching 52.66%. These figures are means over the five splits of our cross-validation run, not the best split (43.68% / 53.81%, Split 3). We report the mean because the splits agree closely: the coefficient of variation of UAR is 1.99% for FERV39k, against 2.82% for DFEW and 14.52% for MAFW. With this little variation, the mean is what a further held-out split would be expected to reproduce. Several large-scale pre-trained ViT-B/16 models in Table VII remain ahead on this dataset, as discussed in the cross-dataset summary below. Per-split results are in the Supplementary Material and Section IV-B4 .
blocks.zh: 与DFEW相比,FERV39k提出了更严重的阶级-不平衡挑战,“Disgust”和“Fear”等少数群体情绪占数据集的一小部分。 表五比较了GM-GREFEL与最强的公布基线。 在表五所列方法中,最强的UAR为35.94%(M3DFEL [28];GM-GREFEL将其提高到42.30%,即+6.36分,而WAR达到52.66%。 这些数字是指我们交叉验证运行的五分制,而不是最好的分制(43.68%/ 53.81%,Split 3). 我们报告这一平均值是因为这些分裂非常一致:FERV39k的UAR变化系数为1.99%,而DFEW为2.82%,MAFW为14.52%。 如果这种变化不大,那么,最坏的就是预期进一步搁置的分裂会再生。 如下文跨数据集摘要所讨论,表七中的几个大规模预先训练的VIT-B/16模型在本数据集中仍然领先. 每个部分的结果载于补充材料和第四至B4节。

blocks.en: TABLE V: UAR and WAR (%) of GM-GReFEL and Published Methods on FERV39k
blocks.zh: 表五:GM-GREFEL和已公布的FERV39k方法的UAR和WAR(%)

blocks.en: FERV39k’s training dynamics follow the same pattern as DFEW, with smooth validation loss decay and no catastrophic forgetting. Its confusion matrix shows the same anatomy-driven error structure: “Disgust” and “Fear” scatter toward classes with overlapping muscular signatures (e.g., “Fear” bleeding into “Sadness”), which suggests that the anchors degrade gracefully under data scarcity (full curves and confusion matrix in the Supplementary Material).
blocks.zh: FERV39k的训练动力学与 DFEW 相同, 顺利的验证损失衰减, 它的混淆矩阵显示了同样的解剖学驱动的错误结构:“混乱”和“恐惧”散射到肌肉特征相重叠的类别(例如“恐惧”出血为“智慧”),这表明锚在数据稀缺(补充材料中的全曲线和混乱矩阵)下会轻而易举地降解。

blocks.en: IV-C 3 MAFW
blocks.zh: 4-C 3 MAFW

blocks.en: MAFW tests a different axis of difficulty: 11-way compound-emotion classification, where categories such as “Disappointment” and “Anxiety” are geometrically close to more basic states. On its best fold, GM-GReFEL reaches 45.66% UAR and 62.27% WAR (Table VI ), which is 3.83 points higher in WAR and 1.94 points higher in UAR than the strongest baseline, S4D [ 39 ] (58.44% WAR, 43.72% UAR). MAFW also has the widest spread across folds. The five-fold mean is 38.90% UAR and 54.37% WAR ( ± \pm 5.65 and ± \pm 6.35), shown in the last row of Table VI . On this basis GM-GReFEL has a lower UAR than T-MEP, DFER-CLIP, and the self-supervised models (39.4–43.7%) and a WAR similar to SVFAP and MAE-DFER (54.28% and 54.31%).
blocks.zh: MAFW测试一个不同的难度轴:11向复合-情绪分类,其中"失望"和"焦虑"等类别几何接近更基本状态. 在最佳水平上,GM-GREFEL达到45.66%的UAR和62.27%的WAR(表六),比最强的基准S4D[39](58.44%的WAR和43.72%的UAR)高出3.83分和1.94分。 MAFW的分布范围也最广。 表六最后一行显示的五倍平均值为:38.90%的UAR和54.37%的WAR(±\pm 5.65%和±\pm 6.35)。 在此基础上,GM-GREFEL的UAR比T-MEP低;DFER-CLIP,以及自我监督的模型(39.4-43.7%)和类似于SVFAP和MAE-DFER(54.28%和54.31%)的WAR.

blocks.en: TABLE VI: UAR and WAR (%) of GM-GReFEL and Published Methods on MAFW
blocks.zh: 表六:全球机制-全球资源评估方法及其公布的MAFW方法的UAR和WAR(%)

blocks.en: MAFW’s training dynamics show strong generalization, with validation loss settling below training loss. Its confusion matrix separates structurally distinct emotions cleanly (Disgust, Fear, Disappointment, and Anger all above 78% true-positive rate) while ambiguous compound classes such as “Surprise” and “Anxiety” scatter toward anatomically adjacent basic emotions, so even the errors follow facial physiology (full curves, confusion matrix, and per-class breakdown in the Supplementary Material).
blocks.zh: MAFW的训练动态显示出强烈的概括性,验证损失在训练损失下结算. 其混乱矩阵将结构上截然不同的情感(Disgust, Fear, Disappointment, and Anger)完全区分开来,而“Surprise”和“Anxiety”等模棱两可的复合类分散到解剖相邻的基本情感中去,因此即使是错误也遵循了面部生理学(完整曲线,混乱矩阵,以及补充材料中每类分解).

blocks.en: IV-C 4 Cross-Dataset Summary
blocks.zh: 四-C 4 交叉数据汇总

blocks.en: Table VII lists the compared methods on all three benchmarks, with GM-GReFEL shown for its best fold and as a five-fold mean. On the best fold, GM-GReFEL has the highest UAR and WAR among all listed methods on MAFW and comes within 0.3 points of S4D on DFEW (66.6% against 66.8% UAR, 76.5% against 76.6% WAR). The five-fold mean is the like-for-like basis for most baselines, and on it the picture is more balanced. On DFEW, GM-GReFEL (64.1% UAR, 74.5% WAR) is level with the recent pre-trained ViT-B/16 models (61.8–64.0% UAR, 74.2–76.0% WAR) and below S4D (66.8%, 76.6%). On MAFW, its mean UAR (38.9%) is below that of T-MEP, DFER-CLIP, and the self-supervised models (39.4–43.7%), while its mean WAR (54.4%) is close to SVFAP and MAE-DFER. On FERV39k, three pre-trained models (MAE-DFER, VideoMAE, and S4D) report higher UAR (43.1–43.4% versus our 42.3%), and S4D also has the higher WAR (53.6% versus 52.7%). Averaged over the three datasets and both metrics, our headline figures give 57.7% against 57.1% for S4D, whereas the five-fold means give 54.5%. We therefore regard GM-GReFEL as competitive with large pre-trained models but not uniformly ahead of them.
blocks.zh: 表七列出了所有三项基准的比较方法,其中GM-GREFEL为最佳折叠,为五倍平均值。 在最好的方面,GM-GREFEL在MAFW上列出的所有方法中拥有最高的UAR和WAR,在DFEW上达到S4D的0.3分(66.6%对66.8%的UAR,76.5%对76.6%的WAR)。 五倍平均值是大多数基线的类似基础,其上图较为平衡. 在DFEW中,GM-GREFEL(64.1% UAR,74.5% WAR)与最近经过预先培训的VIT-B/16型号(61.8-64.0% UAR,74.2-76.0% WAR)和低于S4D(66.8%,76.6%)的水平。 在MAFW上,其平均UAR(38.9%)低于T-MEP,DFER-CLIP,以及自我监督的型号(39.4–43.7%),而其平均WAR(54.4%)接近SVFAP和MAE-DFER. 在FERV39k上,3个预训型号(MAE-DFER、VideoMAE和S4D)报告UAR较高(43.4%比42.3%),S4D也有较高的WAR(53.6%比52.7%). 根据三个数据集和两个指标的平均数,我们头条数字占57.7%,而S4D数字占57.1%,而五倍数字则占54.5%。 因此,我们认为,GM-GREFEL具有对经过预先培训的大型模型的竞争力,但并不统一领先。

blocks.en: IV-D Visualization
blocks.zh: IV-D 可视化

blocks.en: IV-D 1 Training Convergence
blocks.zh: IV-D 1 培训协约

blocks.en: Because DFEW is representative of the general unconstrained-video setting, we use it to illustrate convergence behavior; the same qualitative pattern held across all three datasets. Fig. 4 plots the mean training and validation loss across all five folds, with shaded variance bands. Training loss stabilizes at a visibly higher plateau ( ≈ 1.5 \approx 1.5 ) than validation loss ( ≈ 0.9 \approx 0.9 ); this is the expected consequence of the aggressive 50% dropout applied after the CAM layer during training, which is disabled at validation time. The narrow variance bands across folds indicate that this convergence pattern is not an artifact of any single data split.
Fig. 4: Mean training and validation loss trajectory on DFEW, averaged across all five cross-validation folds with shaded variance bands.
blocks.zh: 发相. 4: DFEW上的平均训练和验证损失轨迹,在所有五个交叉验证折叠上均分有阴影差异带.

blocks.en: UAR and WAR both track a consistent trajectory across training, as shown in Fig. 5 . Both metrics rise sharply during the first 20 epochs and then settle into a stable plateau. The narrow variance bands over the final 50 epochs show that training converges consistently across folds.
blocks.zh: UAR和WAR都跟踪了贯穿训练的一致轨道,如图5所示。 在最初的20个纪元中,这两个指标都急剧上升,然后稳定地落到高地上。 最终50个世纪的狭小差异波段表明,培训始终相互交织。

blocks.en: IV-D 2 Interpretability and Attention Analysis
blocks.zh: 四-D 2 可解释性和注意性分析

blocks.en: To assess whether GM-GReFEL relies on facial physiology or on incidental background cues, we applied Grad-CAM to the final Modulated GroupMamba layer and projected the resulting gradients back onto the input frames. Fig. 6 traces attention across a representative DFEW clip labeled “Angry.” In the earliest frames, attention concentrates on the ocular region as the subject shows a surprise-like widening of the eyes; as the temporal groups detect the characteristic downward brow motion and mouth tightening that follow, attention shifts decisively toward the mouth and jawline by the emotional apex. This suggests that the network follows the temporal evolution of the expression instead of classifying frames in isolation. These are illustrative case studies, not statistical evidence; four further case studies are in the Supplementary Material.
blocks.zh: 为了评估GM-GREFEL是依靠面部生理学还是附带背景提示,我们把Grad-CAM应用到最终的Moduated GroupMamba地层,并将由此产生的梯度投放回输入框上. 图6在标记为“Angry”的DFEW代表剪辑中标出注意。 在最早的帧中,注意力集中在视网膜区域,因为主体显示眼睛的外观有出人意料的拓宽;随着时间群检测到接下来的向下浏览运动和口腔收紧的特征,注意力会由情感顶端决定性地转向口腔和下颚. 这表明网络跟随表达方式的时间演变,而不是孤立地对帧进行分类. 这些是说明性案例研究,而不是统计证据;另外四个案例研究载于补充材料。

blocks.en: Fig. 6: Grad-CAM attention across a DFEW clip labeled “Angry,” showing attention shifting from the ocular region toward the mouth and jawline as the expression reaches its apex.
blocks.zh: 图6:在标记为“Angry,”的DFEW剪辑片段上显示,随着表情达到顶端,注意力从视区转向口腔和下颚。

blocks.en: A direct side-by-side comparison makes the effect concrete: Fig. 7 places attention maps from the full GroupMamba-SSM model against a mean-pooling baseline on the same “Surprise” sample. The baseline’s attention is diffuse, bleeding into hair, clothing, and background; the full model’s attention stays tightly localized on the mouth and eyes and remains stable across the 16-frame sequence. This may reflect the constraint that the geometric anchors place on attention, although the ablation in Section IV-B1 does not isolate their effect on accuracy.
blocks.zh: 直接的并排比较使效果具体化:图7将GroupMamba-SSM模型的注意点地图同同一“Surprise”样本上的平均集合基线相提并论。 基线的注意力是分散的,血流成毛发、衣着和背景;整个模型的注意力在口腔和眼睛上保持紧凑,在16个框架序列中保持稳定。 这可能反映了几何锚地对注意力的制约,尽管第四节-B1中的衰减并没有孤立其对准确性的影响.

blocks.en: Fig. 7: Comparison of attention maps for a “Surprise” sample: full GroupMamba-SSM model (localized on mouth and eyes) vs. a mean-pooling baseline (diffuse, drifting into background).

blocks.zh: IV-D 3 t-SNE 地物空间分析

blocks.en: Projecting the learned 768-dimensional feature space into two dimensions via t t -SNE (Fig. 8 ) offers a complementary, global view of separability. In each case, the architecture forms compact, well-separated clusters with minimal inter-class overlap. Even the 11 compound classes of MAFW remain separable, which agrees with the Triple Loss objective reducing intra-class variance and enlarging inter-class margins in the shared latent space.
blocks.zh: 通过t-SNE(图8)将所学的768维地物空间投射入两个维度,提供了一个互补的,全球的可分性视角. 在每一种情况下,架构都形成紧凑的,紧密相隔的集群,最小的等级间重叠. 即使MAFW的11个复合类也仍然可以分离,这与三重损失的目标是一致的,即减少班内差异,扩大班间在共享潜在空间的比分.

blocks.en: IV-D 4 Confusion and Misclassification Patterns
blocks.zh: IV-D 4 混淆和错分类模式

blocks.en: A radar comparison of per-class recall shared between FERV39k and MAFW, a breakdown of the most frequent misclassification pairs, cross-fold WAR/UAR stability across the full 5-fold cycle, and a comparison of per-class recall against F1-score are given in the Supplementary Material. On FERV39k, seven of the ten most frequent errors involve the “Neutral” class, so the main remaining difficulty there appears to be locating the onset and offset of an expression. On MAFW the frequent errors are spread over pairs of related compound emotions, such as Neutral to Fear, Happiness to Contempt, and Disappointment to Disgust, and only three of the ten involve “Neutral”.

blocks.en: V Limitations
blocks.zh: 五 限制

blocks.en: Three scope constraints bound this study. First, GM-GReFEL is unimodal: it uses visual input only, whereas emotion is also conveyed by voice and gesture, and aligning audio streams with the tubelet schedule is outside the present scope. Second, it performs categorical recognition and does not model dimensional (valence–arousal) affect, because the geometric anchors are tied to discrete class prototypes and cannot directly track blended or graded affect. Third, although the backbone is linear in sequence length, the full pipeline still requires a laboratory-grade GPU to reach the latency in Table VIII ; quantization and pruning for edge deployment remain future work.
blocks.zh: 三项范围限制制约了这项研究。 首先,GM-GREFEL是单模式的:它只使用视觉输入,而情感也通过语音和手势来传递,而将音频流与管子表相接则超出了目前的范围. 第二,它进行绝对的识别,并不影响模型维度(valence-arousal),因为几何锚被绑在离散类原型上,无法直接跟踪混合或分级的影响. 第三,虽然主干线在序列长度上是线性的,但整个管道仍然需要一个实验室级的GPU才能达到表八中的潜伏;量化和挤出边缘部署仍然是今后的工作.

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六. 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented GM-GReFEL, a DFER architecture that jointly addresses the quadratic memory cost of self-attention and the label noise of in-the-wild datasets. A Modulated GroupMamba engine scans orthogonal spatial and temporal channel groups with a linear state-space recurrence and re-couples them through Channel Affinity Modulation, and an entropy-guided geometric reliability module provides an anatomical fallback whenever the statistical prediction is uncertain. On its best fold, GM-GReFEL gives the highest UAR and WAR among the compared methods on MAFW and comes within 0.3 points of the strongest method on DFEW. Its five-fold means are comparable to recent pre-trained models on DFEW and lower on MAFW, and its FERV39k result is competitive. On DFEW, removing temporal modeling costs a small but consistent amount of accuracy according to a paired test. The attention maps stay on the face, the emotion clusters in feature space are well separated, and inference is about as fast as with a ViT-B/16 baseline. Future work includes fusing audio and visual state-space streams, modeling dimensional affect with a continuous anchor manifold, and compressing the model for real-time deployment.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了GM-GREFEL,这是一种DFER架构,它共同解决了自留心的四重内存成本和零散数据集的标签噪声. 一个Modulated GroupMamba引擎扫描正视空间和时间通道组,其线性状态-空间重现,并通过Channel Affinity Modulation将其再相接;而一个Entropy-guided几何可靠性模块则在统计预测不确定时提供解剖回落. GM-GREFEL在MAFW的比较方法中给出了最高的UAR和WAR,在DFEW最强方法的0.3分之内。 它的五倍手段可与DFEW上和MAFW上最近经过预先训练的模型相媲美,它的FERV39k结果具有竞争力. 在 DFEW 上,根据一对测试,去除时间模型需要少量但一致的精度. 注意地图会停留在外观上,地物空间中的情感集群会很好地被分隔开来,推想大概和Vit-B/16基线一样快. 今后的工作包括:将音频和视觉状态-空间流引信;用连续锚地多路来模拟维度影响;以及压缩模型用于实时部署。
